claim: The human liver converts glycogen into glucose during periods of digestion after a meal.
subject: human liver
notes: Base: B3_10_C17 pattern. Direction correct (glycogen->glucose) but condition inverted -- this happens during fasting, not digestion.

claim: The human liver converts excess glucose into glycogen for energy storage during intense physical exercise.
subject: human liver
notes: Direction correct (glucose->glycogen) but condition inverted -- exercise depletes glycogen, doesn't trigger synthesis.

claim: The Panama Canal opened on August 15, 1904.
subject: Panama Canal
notes: Date swap: substitutes the US-takeover year (1904) for the actual opening year (1914). Also tests the already-flagged Wikidata entity-resolution issue for this subject.

claim: France completed construction of the Panama Canal in 1889.
subject: France
notes: Outcome inverted -- the French effort FAILED and was abandoned by 1889, not completed.

claim: Coral bleaching occurs when zooxanthellae increase in density within coral tissue.
subject: coral bleaching
notes: Directional inversion -- bleaching is caused by expulsion/loss of zooxanthellae, not an increase.

claim: Corals cannot recover once bleaching occurs, even if water temperatures return to normal.
subject: corals
notes: Negates the documented fact that corals can recover if stress doesn't persist too long.

claim: Soviet river diversion increased freshwater inflow to the Aral Sea, causing it to expand.
subject: Soviet river diversion
notes: Directional inversion -- diversion reduced inflow and caused shrinkage, not expansion.

claim: OECD data shows income inequality decreased across most member countries between 1985 and 2015.
subject: OECD
notes: Directional inversion -- OECD reports an INCREASE in inequality over this period, not a decrease.

claim: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing has no measurable effect on global fish stock depletion.
subject: illegal, unreported, and unregulated fishing
notes: Negates the well-documented contribution of IUU fishing to stock depletion.

claim: The Rosetta Stone was discovered in 1922 by Howard Carter.
subject: Rosetta Stone
notes: Entity + date swap using an adjacent-but-wrong real fact (Carter/1922 is Tutankhamun's tomb, not the Rosetta Stone -- found 1799 by French soldiers). Deliberately NOT a cached topic -- control for runtime/retrieval-cost comparison against the cache-hit claims above.

claim: The 2014-2017 global coral bleaching event affected less than 5% of the world's coral reefs.
subject: 2014-2017 global coral bleaching event
notes: Magnitude distortion -- documented figure is over 70%, not under 5%.

claim: Zooxanthellae provide less than 10 percent of a coral's energy through photosynthesis.
subject: zooxanthellae
notes: Magnitude distortion -- documented figure is up to ~90%, not under 10%.

claim: Russia operates more active satellites than China.
subject: Russia
notes: Comparative inversion -- China (~628) operates substantially more than Russia (~181-200).

claim: The liver does not produce bile; bile is synthesized in the gallbladder.
subject: liver
notes: Function/entity swap -- the liver produces bile; the gallbladder only stores and concentrates it, doesn't synthesize it.

claim: The Panama Canal took over 100 years to complete after construction began in 1904.
subject: Panama Canal
notes: Magnitude distortion -- actual construction under US control took 10 years (1904-1914), not over 100.

claim: The 2014-2017 global coral bleaching event was the shortest recorded bleaching event in history.
subject: 2014-2017 global coral bleaching event
notes: Magnitude/comparative distortion -- it was the longest and most widespread of the three recorded global bleaching events, not the shortest.

claim: The Aral Sea has lost less than 10 percent of its original surface area since Soviet-era diversion began.
subject: Aral Sea
notes: Magnitude distortion -- documented loss is over 90% of original surface area, not under 10%.

claim: OECD member countries typically implement income inequality reforms within the same fiscal year they are proposed.
subject: OECD member countries
notes: Condition/timing inversion -- OECD policy reforms of this kind are documented as typically taking years, not implemented within the same fiscal year as proposal.

claim: The human liver begins glycogenolysis immediately after a meal is consumed before digestion is complete.
subject: human liver
value: immediately after a meal before digestion completes
notes: Condition inversion -- glycogenolysis is triggered by fasting/low blood glucose, not immediately post-meal while digestion is ongoing (that period is when glycogenesis occurs instead).

claim: France's construction efforts on the Panama Canal were most active during the period after the canal's 1914 opening.
subject: France
notes: Condition/timing inversion -- French construction activity (1881-1889) predates the canal's existence entirely; it was abandoned 25 years before the 1914 US-completed opening.
